name: Graveyard of Shadows (skeletons)
accessNote: Skeletons at the Graveyard of Shadows in the low-level Wilderness (levels 18-21) for Krystilia's task. Family-tuned copy of the zombies-owned graveyard-of-shadows base file (CT-L shared #3). Bring only risk-appropriate gear as PKers frequent the area. The Slayer task/Skeletons table (pageid 298266) lists the Wilderness skeletons as multi-combat and cannonable (not safespottable).
